name: The Eve machine and the server
description: The Eve machine and the server: setup from a folder, control by scripts and by other machines through the doors (IPC, stdio, HTTP), sessions and the machine API `vm.*`, services and routes written in Eve, the editors' link to the machine, and the clients of the machine: `eve` with a user (`-u`, `-a`), the terminal IDE evetx and the native workbench eveux. Capabilities and the Eve Wire Protocol are still open.

features.name: The user cache `eve.db`
features.summary: A SQLite cache of the user (<user data folder>/eve/meta/eve.db): projects, machines without secrets, history of commands, upload manifest; the Meta interface of evecm, implemented by evedb; rebuilt...

features.summary: Client and server, services, protocol, security, HTML, WebAssembly.

features.name: Encryption and hashing
features.summary: Hashes, HMAC, symmetric encryption (manifest).

features.name: HTTP server
features.summary: Routes, request and response records, static files, one state per request.

features.name: Eve Wire Protocol (EWP)
features.summary: Framed binary protocol for Eve-to-Eve calls and data streams, flow control, resumable streams.

features.name: Remote apply
features.summary: Run an aspect on another node with a deadline and an idempotency key.

features.name: Capabilities and sandbox
features.summary: Fs, net, db, shell permissions per project and per aspect.

features.name: Authentication
features.summary: Tokens, sessions, TLS certificates for services.

features.name: Machine login: single sign-on and the keyring
features.summary: From one local machine, a login per remote machine: single sign-on (OpenID Connect), an account of the machine, or a machine token; the renewal token kept in the keyring of the operating system...

features.name: The machine API

features.summary: Socket.set_timeout(ms) (a read fails with $err_timeout), service.idle(ms) and the reply 408, os.run! with timeout_ms (status 124).

features.summary: Remote apply, services, Eve Wire Protocol.
